(function () {
  window.__import = 'start';
  try {
    var b64 = '';
    var bin = atob(b64);
    var arr = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
    for (var i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) arr[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
    var blob = new Blob([arr], { type: 'application/zip' });
    window.__blobSize = blob.size;
    navigator.mozApps.mgmt.import(blob);
    window.__import = 'import-called size=' + blob.size;
  } catch (e) {
    window.__import = 'throw ' + e.name + ':' + e.message;
  }
  return window.__import;
})()
